threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newbies when they say 'the tube' instead of 'the underground'. Also, who needs a jacket in the evening? It's a different climate here.
Caught a glimpse of a bloke in a full suit arguing with a street lamp at 2 AM. He was convinced it was his ex. Real Brixton vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting in the park, I watched a group of kids teach a stray dog to fetch sticks—only in Neukölln could chaos look so cozy.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst from a stand while listening to a spontaneous jam session in the park—it's like street food meets live music.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they roll their eyes when someone calls it 'Frisco'—it's either endearing or a dealbreaker.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, I saw a guy in a tuxedo catch the 19 while balancing a bouquet of roses—classic San Francisco hustle wrapped in elegance.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always misjudge the siesta. It’s not just a nap, it’s when entire streets go silent, like the city is holding its breath.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stand at the tram stop, checking their phones every two minutes like it's a life raft.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app like it's gospel. Real locals just swipe their Oyster and walk, knowing they'll figure it out on the go.
Last night on the 59, couple was arguing about a missing shoe. Ended with him tossing a flip flop out the window. Such a classic Brixton moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids playing football in a back alley while an old man serenaded us with his accordion. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous outdoor film screening at midnight, complete with popcorn from the nearest Späti. It's such a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows not to trust the BART schedule when it's a Giants game night—those special services are all hype, delays are a given.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni last week packed full of tourists. One guy had a sandwich so big it didn’t fit in his lap. Everyone was sharing a laugh—classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: You'd think the street performers are all about music, but half the time they're just shouting random phrases in English to lure in the tourists.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they struggle to find the right plat de dia – asking for the English menu while locals enjoy their homemade fare.
